label: Japan: MHLW and PMDA (PMD Act)
summary: The approval form decides: approved matters need a partial change approval, minor change items a notification within 30 days, and items outside the form no filing. Article 47 keeps some changes out of the minor route. Includes the 2024 moderate change and 2025 annual report trials and the change plan (PACMP) system.

categories.label: Not used in Japan
categories.rule: Japan does not use this tool; see the result for what applies instead.

categories.label: Not an approved matter: managed in the quality system
categories.rule: The item is not in the approval form, so no filing is needed; manage it under GMP and the quality system.

categories.label: Minor change notification
categories.rule: Make the change, then notify within 30 days. PMDA reviews the notification afterwards, with the next partial change application.

categories.label: Annual report item (2025 trial)
categories.rule: For items the approval designates as annual report items: make the change and report it once a year through a PMDA consultation.

categories.label: Notification to the authorities (no approval)
categories.rule: Notify the revised document or fact (for example the package insert, the RMP or a succession); no approval step.

categories.label: Notification under an approved change plan (PACMP step 2)
categories.rule: Notify the change made under the confirmed plan; it becomes an approved matter 40 working days after acceptance (20 in special cases) unless PMDA raises questions.

categories.label: Moderate change: rapid review (2024 trial)
categories.rule: For items designated as moderate change items: a form of partial change application with a short review; implement after approval.

categories.label: Partial change application, rapid review (site changes)
categories.rule: A partial change application for a site change with an unchanged method, reviewed on a rapid track (standard processing time about 3 months).

categories.label: Partial change approval application
categories.rule: Apply for partial change approval and implement only after approval.

categories.label: Change plan confirmation application (PACMP step 1)
categories.rule: Apply for confirmation of the change plan; once confirmed, changes made under it are notified (step 2).

categories.label: New marketing approval application
categories.rule: The change cannot be made by partial change: apply for a new approval (including a replacement application for a new brand name).

multipleChanges.rule: Related changes to one approval are made in one partial change application; minor change items can be notified together. The filing takes the highest category.

MCN.label: Notify within 30 days after the change

JPAR.label: Report once a year from the reference date

NOTIFY.label: Notify the revised document (for a package insert, before distributing it)

PACMPN.label: Becomes an approved matter 40 working days after acceptance (20 in special cases)

MOD.label: Short review: the 2023 proposal aimed at about 30 working days after acceptance (trial; not a fixed rule)

PCAR.label: Rapid partial change: standard processing time about 3 months

PCA.label: Quality changes: median about 6 months (chemical) or 12 months (biologics) in the 2023 survey, not a target. Indications and dosage: 12-month standard target (9 if priority)

NEW.label: New approval: 12-month standard target (9 if priority)
